gaps.current_implementation: ReplSession provides basic eval/dill snapshot, but root_agent.py executes hardcoded code strings and falls back to generic LLM completion.
gaps.intended_architecture: Upstream Prime RLM architecture: LLM drives persistent Python REPL in a multi-turn reasoning and execution loop, using rlm.spawn, rlm.bash, rlm.harness, rlm.mcp, and programmatic data structures.
gaps.gap: Missing autonomous REPL control loop; missing upstream rlm shim compatibility (rlm.spawn, rlm.bash, rlm.harness).
gaps.evidence: services/agent/root_agent.py lines 148-176 show hardcoded prompt checks rather than iterative agent-driven execution.
gaps.recommended_migration: Implement Upstream-compatible RLM kernel shim (rlm/__init__.py, rlm/bash.py, rlm/harness.py) and refactor root_agent.py to an autonomous programmatic loop.

gaps.current_implementation: SubagentManager tracks in-memory dataclass objects without real isolated session execution.
gaps.intended_architecture: Real child subagents spawned into isolated workspaces with dedicated REPL sessions, message queues, and structured result collection.
gaps.gap: Subagents are largely declarative metadata rather than independently executing agents.
gaps.evidence: services/subagents/manager.py returns handle without running async subagent execution loops.
gaps.recommended_migration: Upgrade SubagentManager to spawn and execute real independent child sessions with bounded recursion (depth <= 3).

gaps.current_implementation: services/rlm/harness.py only stores key-value dicts and snapshots.
gaps.intended_architecture: Upstream Harness with typed entries (skills, memory, strategy, subagents, retrieval), immutable base safety policies, and evidence-based refinement.
gaps.gap: Missing structured harness schema, skill refinement lifecycle, and immutable policy enforcement.
gaps.evidence: services/rlm/harness.py lacks create_skill, update_skill, create_memory, create_strategy methods expected by upstream Prime Agent.
gaps.recommended_migration: Adopt upstream rlm/harness.py architecture and integrate with local skills directory.

gaps.current_implementation: MODELS.md contained fabricated SHA256 hashes for draft, abliterated, vision, and mmproj models.
gaps.intended_architecture: All registered models must have authentic, independently verified SHA256 hashes and tested inference performance.
gaps.gap: Documentation hash discrepancy vs actual files.
gaps.evidence: Actual SHA256 hashes verified via PowerShell Get-FileHash differ from MODELS.md for 4 out of 5 files.
gaps.recommended_migration: Update models.json and MODELS.md with real cryptographic hashes and add automated hash verification in doctor.ps1.

gaps.current_implementation: Static port mapping in model_manager.py with basic router.
gaps.intended_architecture: Dynamic capability-aware router selecting between LOW_MEMORY, BALANCED, QUALITY profiles, handling on-demand loading and VRAM eviction.
gaps.gap: Missing multi-tier hardware profiles and automated model unloading.
gaps.evidence: services/llm/router.py has hardcoded fallback to primary model without memory-aware eviction.
gaps.recommended_migration: Build multi-tier profile manager (LOW_MEMORY: 4B, BALANCED: 4B+spec, QUALITY: 8B if available) with LRU model lifecycle.

gaps.current_implementation: tiny-sd generates 256x256 low quality images; img2img is basic noise overlay without mask/inpainting; QA is purely CV edge variance.
gaps.intended_architecture: Decoupled image agent, on-demand loading, real semantic editing, and VLM-based requirement verification checklist.
gaps.gap: Toy image model, naive editing, and absence of semantic VLM image verification.
gaps.evidence: services/image/qa.py only computes Laplacian variance and color histograms; does not query VLM to check prompt compliance.
gaps.recommended_migration: Integrate VLM-based semantic QA checklist (prompts vs generated visual elements) and modularize image backend.

gaps.current_implementation: Custom JSON-RPC server/client in services/mcp/ mimicking some MCP methods.
gaps.intended_architecture: Compliance with official MCP schema (tools/list with JSONSchema, tools/call with content blocks, proper error and cancellation handling).
gaps.gap: Custom implementation diverged from standard MCP SDK/specification.
gaps.evidence: services/mcp/server.py does not use mcp package protocol types even though mcp package is installed.
gaps.recommended_migration: Rebuild MCP layer using official mcp Python SDK and upstream rlm/mcp.py conventions.

gaps.current_implementation: services/agent/self_healing.py applies text replacements without automatic state rollback if verification fails.
gaps.intended_architecture: Pre-repair snapshot, controlled patch application, targeted + regression testing, and mandatory rollback upon failure.
gaps.gap: Self-healing is not fully transactional or reversible.
gaps.evidence: services/agent/self_healing.py does not call harness snapshot or rollback.
gaps.recommended_migration: Tie SelfHealingCoordinator directly to HarnessStateManager snapshot/rollback.

gaps.current_implementation: benchmark.ps1 only measures single speculative decoding run without comparative baseline.
gaps.intended_architecture: Comparative benchmarks: Baseline vs Speculative, KV Cache F16 vs Q8/Q4, Flash Attention ON vs OFF.
gaps.evidence: benchmarks/ only contained single report_1789472951.json without comparative runs.
gaps.recommended_migration: Implement benchmark_matrix.py executing baseline vs draft, KV cache modes, and generating benchmarks/baseline.json and benchmarks/upgraded.json.

gaps.current_implementation: PrimeDaemon heartbeat loop only sleeps and checks if running.
gaps.intended_architecture: State-aware heartbeat inspecting active goals, progressing subagent tasks, monitoring system memory, and executing maintenance.
gaps.evidence: services/agent/daemon.py heartbeat loop contains only asyncio.sleep and passive logging.
gaps.recommended_migration: Upgrade heartbeat to inspect goals.json, check pending tasks, and trigger agent steps.
